stages.name: Genome to candidate proteins

gate.rule: a row is kept when at least one of 4 evidence terms pays 0.5 points or more. Conservation is not among them: it says how well this genome was recognised, not whether what was recognised is worth aiming at

stages.hands_to_next: one reviewed accession and one residue range per candidate

stages.name: Polyproteins to mature chains, and the score for each

gate.rule: a row is kept when at least one of 4 evidence terms pays 0.5 points or more. Conservation is not among them: it says how well this genome was recognised, not whether what was recognised is worth aiming at

stages.hands_to_next: every chain that cleared the gate, with the accession and range its surface is measured on. 3 did not clear it and go no further: nothing below this line folds them, measures them or looks for literature on them

stages.name: Every chain to coordinates, whole where it fits and by its functional regions where it does not
stages.hands_to_next: coordinates for 1 of the 5 chains it reported on -- whole where the chain fits the 400-residue ceiling, and by up to 3 of its annotated functional regions where it does not, which rescued 0 of the 4 chains over it. Plus the functional site positions, carried through the alignment into this genome's numbering, which the surface stage anchors the patch arithmetic on. 4 chains end with no coordinates by either route. The surface stage measures what it is given with the same arithmetic it uses on a deposition and reports the two apart; a region's surface goes under its chain's row and never as a row of its own. It reorders nothing: the ranking was final at the end of stage 2

stages.name: Every chain to a measured surface, and the patch at the residues that do the chemistry
stages.hands_to_next: a patch median and range per chain, the residues the patch is made of, and the patch measured at the marked functional residues on 3 chains through a deposition and 1 through a prediction. No LATER STAGE reads any of it: `SURFACE_READ_BY` is empty and so is `LIBRARY_READS_FROM_SURFACE`, and stage 5 defines the same library whatever this stage found. The site figures are the stage's product for a reader designing a binder rather than an input to anything downstream, which is a narrower claim than the one this key used to make and the honest one

stages.name: A library definition over the randomised region

input.not_connected_because: the library definition takes an initiator, a randomised-region length range and a set of elongator classes, all three properties of the display platform rather than of a target. No stated rule turns a measured patch area into any of them, and inventing one would publish a conversion as a result.

stages.hands_to_next: the position count the go/no-go test in arm 2 reads

stages.name: Evidence on the highest-ranked targets
stages.hands_to_next: nothing. This annotates the shortlist and never reorders it

site_surface.anchors_numbering: author numbering of the deposited chain, taken as 1-based within the mature chain the relative's entry delimits
site_surface.not_the_annotated_residues_because: 1 of the 1 anchors this measurement was taken at do not carry the residue the annotation names there -- 83 carries L where the relative's entry has R at 109. An annotated position is offered to a structure as `position - chain_start + 1`, which is right for a deposition of the mature chain and wrong for a construct numbered from its own first residue or for a chain deposited in the parent polyprotein's numbering; a deliberately mutated construct and a substitution across the species gap read the same way from here. The figures in this block were measured at the residues named above and are reported rather than withheld so that they can be seen to be the wrong ones, but they are not the annotated site.

predicted_surface.caveat: A patch computed on predicted coordinates. It inherits the prediction's error, a monomer's surface is not necessarily exposed in an oligomer, and over a low-confidence stretch it describes a fold the model did not commit to. Reported beside a deposited measurement and never pooled with one.
